final:
settings(keys: List[str], values: List[str]) -> List[str] =
  pre keys.len() == values.len()
  post out.len() >= 2
  ex settings([], []) == ["fast", "3"]
  ex settings(["level"], ["5"]) == ["fast", "5"]
  ex settings(["x", "mode"], ["1", "slow"]) == ["slow", "3", "1"]
  var mode = "fast"
  var level = "3"
  var ks: List[str] = []
  var vs: List[str] = []
  for i in range(0, keys.len())
    let k = keys[i]
    let v = values[i]
    if k == "mode"
      mode = copy v
    else
      if k == "level"
        level = copy v
      else
        var found = False
        for j in range(0, ks.len())
          if ks[j] == k
            vs[j] = copy v
            found = True
        if not found
          ks.append(copy k)
          vs.append(copy v)
  var res: List[str] = []
  res.append(mode)
  res.append(level)
  for v in vs
    res.append(copy v)
  res
